en: Black‑and‑white image of a rocky seaside bathing area and informal campsite. Vintage cars from the 1930s–1940s are parked on the sandy and grassy shore, with several canvas tents pitched nearby. People in swimsuits are wading in a shallow, protected bay formed by rocks, while others walk, cycle, or relax on the beach and rocky slopes. Low, rocky islands and headlands stretch across the horizon, suggesting a rugged northern coastline.
